<function name="Refresh" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Refreshes the HTML panel's current page.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ignoreCache" type="boolean" default="false">If true, the refresh will ignore cached content similar to "ctrl+f5" in most browsers.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
